added_models.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)

engagement.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)
engagement.quote: Additionally, PF00299804 is a highly effective inhibitor of both the wild-type ERBB2 and the gefitinib-resistant oncogenic ERBB2 mutation identified in lung cancers.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Engelman 2007 (not open access); the ERBB2-mutant work is reported as cell-based, no HER2-mutant xenograft is described in the abstract, hence model_kind ex_vivo (no cell-line enum value). Kris 2015 lists no pharmacodynamic endpoint.
engagement.note: Dacomitinib inhibited the gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 insertion mutant in cells; no HER2-mutant patient tumour PD readout was ever taken.
engagement.short: No HER2-mutant tumour PD readout in patients
engagement.judgement: The cell model's readout is ERBB2 kinase inhibition; the HER2 cohort of NCT00818441 (Kris 2015) measured response, survival and toxicity only, so engagement was never compared.

dose.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)
dose.quote: Additionally, PF00299804 is a highly effective inhibitor of both the wild-type ERBB2 and the gefitinib-resistant oncogenic ERBB2 mutation identified in lung cancers.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Engelman 2007 (not open access); the ERBB2-mutant work is reported as cell-based, no HER2-mutant xenograft is described in the abstract, hence model_kind ex_vivo (no cell-line enum value).
dose.note: Cell potency against the ERBB2 mutant stated; no exposure target or tolerated-dose margin was given for HER2-mutant tumours.
dose.short: No exposure target stated for HER2 mutant
dose.judgement: Opening entry at first use; the cell model gives IC50-level potency only, so the dose cell can be scored only by the efficacy row once patients were dosed.

dose.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)
dose.magnitude_basis: full 30-45 mg daily (MTD) regimen delivered; 3/26 responders
dose.quote: Dacomitinib produced objective responses in patients with lung cancers with specific HER2 exon 20 insertions.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract only: the Annals full text is paywalled and the PDF fetch was denied, so the cohort's statistical bar is unread. This dose call follows the efficacy call ('reached, drug worked'); if efficacy is rescored contra under the checker's rule question 2, this becomes contra with derived_from efficacy.
dose.note: Dacomitinib 30-45 mg daily (the MTD regimen) was delivered to the HER2 cohort of NCT00818441; durable responses occurred in 3/26 HER2 exon-20-mutant patients.
dose.judgement: Table row 'reached, drug worked': the regimen the EGFR-mutant cohort used was given in full and responses occurred, but the model stated no exposure target, so margin_stated is false and magnitude is direction only.
dose.reason: MTD regimen reached; responses in HER2-mutant cohort

efficacy.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)
efficacy.quote: These preclinical evaluations support further clinical development of PF00299804 for cancers with mutations and/or amplifications of ERBB family members.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Engelman 2007 (not open access); the ERBB2-mutant work is reported as cell-based, no HER2-mutant xenograft is described in the abstract, hence model_kind ex_vivo (no cell-line enum value). The dacomitinib FDA review cites Engelman 2007 only for the EGFR (H1975, HCC827-Del/T790M) xenograft figures and mentions HER2 only as the ARCHER 1017 cohort B eligibility, so the HER2-mutant cell model was not relied on in the filing (model_filed false).
efficacy.note: Cell models with the gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 insertion predicted dacomitinib activity in HER2-mutant lung cancer; no patients yet.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry at first use (2007); Engelman 2007 names ERBB2-mutant lung cancer as a development population for PF00299804.

efficacy.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)
efficacy.magnitude_basis: ORR 12% (3/26, HER2-mutant cohort B) vs 54% (48/89 best overall response, EGFR-mutant cohort A) in the same trial, registry BOR table; the same cell system predicted both

patient_trials.quote: Three of 26 patients with tumors harboring HER2 exon 20 mutations [12%; 95% confidence interval (CI) 2% to 30%] had partial responses lasting 3+, 11, and 14 months.

efficacy.quote: Three of 26 patients with tumors harboring HER2 exon 20 mutations [12%; 95% confidence interval (CI) 2% to 30%] had partial responses lasting 3+, 11, and 14 months.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract only (paywalled; PDF fetch denied): the HER2 cohort's pre-specified response bar is not readable, so the primary-endpoint rule cannot be applied strictly. Registry (results posted 2016-06-01): cohort B 4-month PFS 24.9%, median PFS 2.6 months, 3 PR of 30. The checker's open rule question 2 (below-bar response: contra or same with magnitude) applies; rescoring to contra would carry the 2015 dose entry with it.
efficacy.note: HER2 cohort of NCT00818441: 3/26 HER2 exon-20-mutant patients responded (12%, CI 2-30%), 0/4 amplified; authors call the insertions validated actionable targets.
efficacy.judgement: Stated comparison: Kris 2015 names the cell-line models as the premise and calls the exon-20 responses a validation. Direction agreed (durable PRs only in insertion-mutant tumours, none in amplified) but 12% ORR with a 2% lower CI is 4-5x below what the same system predicted and delivered for del19/L858R; scored same with magnitude rather than contra because no pre-specified bar is readable and the predicted effect was present, not absent (decision 4).

safety.model: Gefitinib-resistant ERBB2 (HER2) exon 20 insertion-mutant lung-cancer cell models (dacomitinib, Engelman 2007)
safety.quote: These preclinical evaluations support further clinical development of PF00299804 for cancers with mutations and/or amplifications of ERBB family members.
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Engelman 2007 (not open access); the ERBB2-mutant work is reported as cell-based, no HER2-mutant xenograft is described in the abstract, hence model_kind ex_vivo (no cell-line enum value). Kris 2015 abstract: diarrhoea 90% (grade 3/4 20%/3%), dermatitis 73%, one death from a dacomitinib-mirtazapine interaction.
safety.note: Cell model silent on tolerability; the diarrhoea, dermatitis and one interaction death in Kris 2015 are harms a cell line cannot show.
safety.short: Cell model cannot show GI or skin toxicity
safety.judgement: A cell line cannot show diarrhoea, rash or drug interactions, so its silence is not a miss (v3 safety rule); the species comparison lives on the rat/dog toxicology track.
safety.reason: Cell line cannot show diarrhoea or rash

added_models.model: Structure-based (in silico) classification of EGFR mutations with Ba/F3 sensitivity panels (MD Anderson: classical-like / T790M-like / Ex20ins-L near- vs far-loop / PACC)

efficacy.model: Structure-based (in silico) classification of EGFR mutations with Ba/F3 sensitivity panels (MD Anderson: classical-like / T790M-like / Ex20ins-L near- vs far-loop / PACC)
efficacy.quote: We found that EGFR mutations can be separated into four distinct subgroups on the basis of sensitivity and structural changes that retrospectively predict patient outcomes following treatment with EGFR inhibitors better than traditional exon-based groups.
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC8481125). Poziotinib and tarloxotinib-E are in the Ba/F3 panel (Ex20ins-L 'sensitive only to select second-generation TKIs (that is, poziotinib and tarlox-TKI)'); the retrospective patient validation is afatinib ORR/DOT (Uncommon EGFR Database) and pooled second-generation TTF, and the only member-drug patient datum is one poziotinib-treated L858R/L718V case (Extended Data Fig. 9b).
efficacy.note: Classification built on 16,715 patients' mutations and Ba/F3 panels; its patient validation used afatinib (non-member) ORR/DOT and pooled second-generation TTF.
efficacy.short: Validated on afatinib, not a member drug
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry: the model's own retrospective patient comparison is for a non-member drug, so under the member-drug rule the track stays untested until a member drug is compared (Elamin 2022).

efficacy.model: Structure-based (in silico) classification of EGFR mutations with Ba/F3 sensitivity panels (MD Anderson: classical-like / T790M-like / Ex20ins-L near- vs far-loop / PACC)
efficacy.magnitude_basis: ORR 46% near-loop vs 0% far-loop (p = 0.0015) against an in vitro / in silico sensitivity ranking with no predicted response rate

patient_trials.quote: The study achieved its primary endpoint, with confirmed objective response rates (ORRs) of 32% and 31% by investigator and blinded independent review, respectively, with a median progression-free survival of 5.5 months.

efficacy.quote: poziotinib sensitivity was highly dependent on the insertion location, with near-loop insertions (amino acids A767 to P772) being more sensitive than far-loop insertions, an observation confirmed clinically with ORRs of 46% and 0% observed in near versus far-loop, respectively
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Elamin 2022 (PMC9667883). NCT03066206 started 2017-03 and its 50-patient cohort had read out before the near-/far-loop split was published (Robichaux 2021, Sept 2021); the same group held both, so the clinical confirmation is a retrodiction (decision 10). Registry: no results posted (completion 2026-02-16).
efficacy.note: Near- vs far-loop split (Ba/F3 plus in silico/MD modelling) matched poziotinib ORR 46% vs 0% in NCT03066206 patients already treated; a retrodiction.
efficacy.judgement: Stated comparison on a member drug at patient level: the structure-based insertion-location prediction reproduced the known poziotinib responses by subgroup of the primary ORR measure (primary endpoint itself met, 32%). Retro, never same, because the classification was built after those patients' responses were known; no prospective member-drug trial on the classification was found (the PACC trials are afatinib).
efficacy.reason: Insertion-location prediction reproduced known poziotinib responses

Robichaux 2021 PACC and classical-like/T790M-like retrodictions (afatinib ORR 63% vs 20% sensitive vs resistant groups; PACC afatinib DOT 17.1 months; PACC second-generation TTF 21.7 months): afatinib is not a member drug, so these stay as the note on the in-silico track's opening entry rather than scoring it; the subsequent prospective PACC trials are afatinib as well.

NCT04504071 (dacomitinib in NSCLC with uncommon EGFR mutations, phase 2, start 2020-12-08, active not recruiting, no results, no primary publication found): no model is paired with it, and it began before the 2021 classification, so it is not a prospective test of the in-silico track.

Patient-derived organotypic spheroids / organoids for HER2-mutant NSCLC (Ivanova 2020 Clin Cancer Res 10.1158/1078-0432.ccr-19-1844, combination screening; 2026 Hum Vaccin Immunother organoid drug-sensitivity case): titles only, no member-drug patient comparison evident; not opened.

In-silico dose models (PBPK, population PK, exposure-response, QSP) for dacomitinib, poziotinib, pyrotinib or tarloxotinib in NSCLC: the search returned reviews and non-member PK papers only; nothing pairing a model-chosen dose with a member-drug patient result.
Pyrotinib HER2 exon 20 PDO/PDX (Wang 2019) and poziotinib EGFR/HER2 exon 20 Ba/F3-PDX-GEMM (Robichaux 2018): already tracked in the draft.
